utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the twenty-fifth. Can you all hear me over that fan?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, just. My grand weekend plans ended up being sitting indoors watching the rain. Weather forecast absolutely stitched us up.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Bank holiday weather, that. Comes as part of the package.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: On a brighter note, there's a birthday cake in the office. Under the blue lid.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Ah. That explains the very clean knife and the suspiciously large missing bit.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Not naming names. Mostly because I've still got crumbs on me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes a cake investigation. What's already finished?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah so, I tested the Gas Turbine 1 yesterday and it's all fine now. That's finished, nothing outstanding from that test.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, it's been behaving since. Much nicer shift without that hanging over us.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Exactly. Just closing the loop, not putting it back on today's list.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And I already swapped the filter on the pick and place on two yesterday. That one's done as well.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I saw the pressure on the pick and place on two dip for a few minutes. Came back on its own, though.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Was that a continuing drop, or just that little patch?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Just that patch. No ongoing fault to report; it recovered without anyone touching it. Only an observation.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, noted as an observation, not another job.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: The supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the Main Outfeed Conveyor, either. Same blocker as before.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, there's no confirmed delivery showing on my side. Nothing new behind that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That stays blocked, then. No fresh action out of that this morning.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Dave, can you clear the jam and check the sensors on the Palletiser, Monday? That's today.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, um—is that the jam itself and the sensor checks, rather than just getting it moving again?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Both, please. Clear the jam and check the sensors on the Palletiser.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Right, I'll do both on the Palletiser today, Monday.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Sorry, your last bit went all robotic there. I heard 'both', then a sort of underwater noise.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That might just be my normal voice. But yes, both, today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And Dave, can you take vibration readings on the compressor one, Monday as well? No rush on that.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Readings only for that one, yeah? Not rolling the bearing greasing into it?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's right. This one's just the vibration readings on the compressor one. Separate from the bearing work.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yep, I'll take the vibration readings on the compressor one Monday. Understood, no rush.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: On that separate bit, we do need someone to grease and check the bearings on the compressor one tomorrow. No rush, though.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anyone able to take that bearing job?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I can't commit to that as well. Don't put it against me just because I'm doing the readings.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: No, and I'm only flagging it, not volunteering for it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, nobody on it. Grease and check the bearings on the compressor one remains unallocated, due tomorrow, no rush.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Um, I'll send the shift handover report round by Thursday. It's fairly important, that one.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: That's the shift handover report we've been talking about, not a separate quality report?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, that same shift handover report. I'll get it round by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Fiona. Got that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie, can you schedule downtime for the dryer with production, tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah—just so we're saying the same thing, tomorrow is when I need to get the downtime scheduled, not a promise that the dryer will actually be down tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct. Schedule it with production tomorrow. We're not setting the shutdown date in this call.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Fine, I'll schedule downtime for the dryer with production tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Glad you separated those. 'Scheduled tomorrow' and 'scheduled for tomorrow' get treated as the same thing far too often.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Usually about thirty seconds before someone asks where all their output's gone.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fiona, can you recalibrate the sensors on the line 3 chiller Monday? Fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep, I'll recalibrate the sensors on the line 3 chiller Monday. Got it, fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Sorry, Monday as in today? Teams clipped the start for me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Today, yes. Monday the twenty-fifth.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, that's what I've got for the line 3 chiller. Today.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And I'll book a contractor to look at the stretch wrapper. That's a whenever you get a chance one, isn't it? I'll take it on that basis.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, Davey, whenever you get a chance. Booking a contractor to look at the stretch wrapper, not promising a visit date here.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Exactly. I'll make the booking; no fixed date being agreed on this call.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Different name for the contractor jobs, then?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Same bloke, unfortunately. No extra pair of hands included.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And to avoid any crossed wires, the bearings on the compressor one still have nobody. The readings being covered doesn't change that.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Likewise, that Main Outfeed Conveyor delivery is still unconfirmed. Wouldn't want the blocker to sound like a delivery promise.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Agreed. Still blocked, nothing newly assigned there.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: All clear from me. Nothing else to add to the list.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Same here. And the cake was information, by the way, not a compulsory team activity.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Good. I'd hate to have to record my slice.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, that's us. Thanks, everyone.
